**Supervision** will be executed by Giancarlos Parady, an expert in human-centric urban and transport planning at the University Tokyo, and Allister Loder, experienced Professor for Mobility Policy at Technical University of Munich.

**Costs** are estimated at 12,450€ in total, incl. Flight: 1,000€ x 2 = 2,000€ Living cost: 2,000€/month x 5 months = 10,000€ Preparatory language course: 450€

**Timeline** is shown in Table 1: The stay at UTokyo is planned from October 2026 until February 2027 with phases for preparation and follow-up work before and after the stay, carried out in Germany. Giancarlos Parady will visit the TUM from October 2025 until January 2026 where we will work on preparatory work for the field work panned in Japan.
